Delivery Driver (Own Vehicle)
Copperline Courier Co.
Surrey, BC
Pay: $21.00–$24.00 per hour
Job type: Part-time, Contract
Shift and schedule: Day shift, Monday to Friday, Weekends as needed

Full job description
We're hiring friendly, reliable drivers to deliver parcels and pharmacy orders to homes and businesses across Surrey, Delta and White Rock.

What you'll do
• Load your vehicle at our hub each morning and plan your route with our driver app
• Deliver 60 to 90 parcels a day and get a signature or photo proof for each one
• Handle prescription deliveries with care and keep them private
• Report damaged parcels or address problems to dispatch right away

What you need
• Your own reliable vehicle (car, SUV or minivan) with valid insurance
• A smartphone with a data plan (iOS or Android)
• Must be 19+ with a clean driving record
• Able to lift parcels up to 25 kg

Job Types: Part-time, Contract

Pay: $21.00-$24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20 – 35 per week

Benefits:
• Fuel reimbursement
• On-site parking
• Flexible schedule

Schedule:
• Day shift
• Monday to Friday
• Weekends as needed

Application question(s):
• Do you have your own vehicle with commercial insurance?
• Are you 19 years of age or older?

Experience:
• delivery driver: 1 year (preferred)

Licence/Certification:
• Class 5 Driver's Licence (required)

Work Location: On the road
